entry.title: New: RES24-270 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF GIFT BOXES AND TWO TICKETS TO THE HAWAI’I BOWL ON DECEMBER 24, 2024, WITH AN ESTIMATED VALUE OF $898 FROM SERVPRO FOR ITS “HONOR A FIRST RESPONDER AWARD” TO PRESENT TO SELECTED INDIVIDUALS FROM THE CITY’S DEPARTMENT OF EMERGENCY SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF OCEAN SAFETY, THE HONOLULU FIRE DEPARTMENT AND THE HONOLULU POLICE DEPARTMENT.

Latest action: Adopted.
